policy: Expand the pinned es-MX affix/dictionary pair with pinned nspell; lowercase NFC Spanish-letter surface forms accepted by that parser, lengths4–7 only. Keep diacritics and Ñ distinct. This is a spelling-variant resource, not frequency or uniquely Mexican vocabulary certification.

teachingScope.authoredFieldProvenance: Short English gloss, Spanish example and English rendering are original AI-authored educational material, independently model-reviewed for natural Mexican usage. Not source quotations; no human/native certification.
teachingScope.definitionProvenance: Sense-selected Wiktionary definitions and reviewed translations of Spanish base senses; CINTERO from a French entry explicitly linked to Spanish. CC-BY-SA4.0, pinned revisions, snapshots/extracts and upstream hashes. No FreeDict material.
teachingScope.morphologyPolicy: Historical independent model audit of the original400 teaching-linked answer senses. Kept as teaching provenance, not the current eligibility criterion. Current answer generation uses answer-selection.json and the independent frequency/lexical policy.

answerScope.policy: Zipf>=3.5 general-Spanish spelling frequency plus a documented independent nonplural base-word sense, source usage/region exclusions and reviewed homograph/suitability decisions. No per-length cap; teaching coverage never gates eligibility.
answerScope.review: Independent model review of every provisional candidate; not native-human certification or exhaustive sense-specific frequency data.
